run_coco_handler_multi_label: run the coco_handler function with is_multi_label True to process MS-COCO dataset for multi-label classification
run_coco_handler_single_label: run the coco_handler function with is_multi_label False to process MS-COCO dataset for single-label classification
create_single_label_generator: create a generator that yields cropped object images with single labels from COCO annotations using _single_label_gen
create_multi_label_generator: create a generator that yields full images with multi-label category arrays from COCO annotations using _multi_label_gen
download_coco_single_label_dataset: download and register the coco_single_label_dataset DownloadableDataset with all COCO 2017 image and annotation zip URLs
